description: Is a decision-support tool using NASA SMAP and POWER data to optimize crop rotations for soil health and water conservation. We are modeling contrasting climates—from Madison, WI (corn, soy, winter cover crops) to Costa Rica (corn, beans, tropical rotation)—to help farmers adapt to extreme weather. Looking for teammates interested in data analysis, agriculture, or UI/UX design to build a functional, data-driven prototype!
